response.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
    SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
    FROM scanqc
    GROUP BY arcref
), shares AS (
    SELECT
        arcref,
        qc_count,
        qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share,
        qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER ()
            - AVG(qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER ()) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM project_counts
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        arcref,
        qc_count,
        share,
        deviation,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deviation DESC) AS deviation_rank
    FROM shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation
FROM ranked
WHERE deviation_rank <= 10
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: Projects means distinct arcref values that occur in scanqc; shares and the average share are computed across those projects. The cutoff includes all ties at the 10th-highest deviation.
